description: Fetch and import creative-level spend from a configured Meta, Google or TikTok connection. AttriKit already pulls every enabled connection every 6 hours, covering today and the 3 days before; call this for an immediate pull or a longer window. Report rows are kept only for campaigns whose network id AttriKit knows (create_campaign_link.network_campaign_id); if none match, the call fails and imports nothing. A network reports rows only for ads that have delivered, so the first useful pull is after the ads start spending.

connection_id.description: The integration id, as returned by list_integrations. Needed only when several integrations of this network are active (otherwise 409 ambiguous_connection); omitted, the one active integration is used.

covers_from.description: First day of the report window to pull, YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive.

covers_to.description: Last day of the report window to pull, YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive, on or after covers_from.

idempotency_key.description: Stable retry key for this exact mutation.

network.description: The network to pull from: meta, google or tiktok. It needs an active integration.

name: pull_network_spend
title: Pull spend from an ad network
